title: panarica neglecta
intro: Panarica neglecta, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the family Passifloraceae, is a tropical climber native to Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which help to soothe digestive issues and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Panarica neglecta include antihypertensive and antispasmodic effects, which can help to lower blood pressure and relax muscles. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional medicine.
